title: How GE Went From American Icon to Astonishing Mess - Bloomberg
主要内容: General Electric Co. (GE) has been a symbol of American innovation and corporate success for over a century. From the invention of the lightbulb to the development of jet engines and industrial plastics, GE has played a pivotal role in shaping modern technology and daily life. Throughout its 126-year history, the company has exemplified the power of corporate capitalism, manufacturing consumer products, industrial machinery, and even producing romantic comedies. GE has also contributed to significant historical events, including world wars, and has consistently rewarded investors despite economic downturns and technological disruptions. However, the article highlights a shift from this legacy of success to a more complex and challenging situation, setting the stage for a deeper exploration of GE's transformation.
